formatOverview.summary: Matches are played in Men's Doubles format with two active players from each team on court at all times. Scoring begins at 0–0 and the first team to reach 100 points wins, strictly subject to mandatory elimination and full-squad participation rules.

milestones.title: FIRST ELIMINATION
milestones.subtitle: 25 Points Milestone
milestones.description: The opposing captain selects one active player from the team reaching 25 points for immediate mandatory elimination. An unused squad member enters court.

milestones.title: SECOND ELIMINATION
milestones.subtitle: 50 Points Milestone
milestones.description: Mid-match tactical checkpoint. A second mandatory elimination is enforced by the opposing captain, testing squad depth and fresh doubles chemistry.

milestones.title: THIRD ELIMINATION
milestones.subtitle: 75 Points Milestone
milestones.description: Final elimination checkpoint entering the championship stretch. Teams must balance closing power with remaining squad participation obligations.

milestones.title: MATCH VICTORY
milestones.subtitle: 100 Points Target
milestones.description: First team to reach 100 points claims victory — provided every registered squad member has stepped on court during the match.

officialRules.title: Mandatory Elimination
officialRules.text: Elimination at each milestone (25, 50, and 75 points) is mandatory and cannot be waived or deferred.

officialRules.title: Opposing Captain Selection
officialRules.text: At each elimination milestone, the opposing captain selects one of the two active players on court to be eliminated.

officialRules.title: Immediate Replacement
officialRules.text: A replacement player from the squad must immediately enter the court before play resumes.

officialRules.title: Unused Replacement Requirement
officialRules.text: The incoming replacement player must not have previously played in that match.

officialRules.title: Permanent Match Removal
officialRules.text: Eliminated players cannot return to the court for the remainder of that match.

officialRules.title: Voluntary Substitutions
officialRules.text: Voluntary substitutions are permitted after the completion of any rally.

officialRules.title: Continuous Doubles Formation
officialRules.text: Two players from each team must always be on court throughout the match.

officialRules.title: Full Squad Participation
officialRules.text: Every team member on the match roster must participate before their team reaches 100 points.

officialRules.title: No Minimum Playing Time
officialRules.text: There is no minimum playing time or minimum points requirement for a player's participation to count.

officialRules.title: Participation Compliance Enforcement
officialRules.text: If a team reaches 100 points without all team members having participated, the opposing team is awarded the victory.
